{"code": "from typing import Any

def note_finding(title: str, finding: str, implication: str) -> Any:
    """Log a finding with its implication for analysis."
    print(f"[FINDING] {title}")
    print(f"  Finding: {finding}")
    print(f"  Implication: {implication}")
    return None

# Now call note_finding with the correct information
note_finding(
    title="Duplicate patient entries",
    finding="Multiple rows per patient (via `sample_seq`) exist in the data. The highest `sample_seq` per patient was used to retain the most recent measurement, as per the data dictionary guidance.",
    implication="Failure to deduplicate would have inflated the sample size and distorted the baseline severity distribution."
)"}
